dictation.autoSendHint: Automatically press Enter after inserting transcribed text
dictation.correctionsHint: Automatically replace dictation output. Useful for technical terms.
dictation.hotkeyHint: Hold the hotkey to start recording, release to stop. Short presses pass through as normal input.
dictation.languageHint: Auto-detect works well for most languages.
dictation.longPressHint: How long to hold the key before dictation starts. 0 = instant (no short-press pass-through), higher = fewer accidental triggers.
dictation.microphoneHint: Select the input device to use for dictation.
dictation.modelHint: Choose a model. Larger models are more accurate but slower.
dictation.noSpeechHint: Discards a transcript when Whisper itself reports it probably heard no speech. Lower is stricter; 100% turns the gate off.
dictation.rmsHint: Audio quieter than this never reaches Whisper. Raise it until room noise stays below the marker; lower it if quiet speech is rejected.
dictation.title: Dictation Settings
dictation.tuningHint: Record a test phrase and watch where your voice sits against the gates. Text stays in this panel — nothing is sent to a terminal.

general.hint.aiChat: Enable the AI Chat panel, keyboard shortcut, and command palette entry.
general.hint.aiTriage: Enable AI-powered diff triage to classify changed files by relevance and risk.
general.hint.aiWatchers: Enable terminal watchers that trigger AI actions on shell events (idle, busy, errors).
general.hint.autoUpdateEnabled: Download and install updates in the background
general.hint.blockFolding: Let the Toggle Block Fold shortcut collapse a command block's output. Already-folded blocks stay collapsed when this is off.
general.hint.cliInfo: The TUIC CLI lets you control TUICommander from any terminal or script. Open files and URLs as tabs, manage PTY sessions (create, list, send input, read output), and query repository status. Useful for scripting automation.
general.hint.cliNotInstalled: Install the TUIC CLI to control TUICommander from any terminal or script. Open files and URLs as tabs, manage PTY sessions, and query repository status. Useful for scripting automation.
general.hint.codeIntelligenceInfo: Integrates with MDKB to provide code navigation features in the editor: Cmd+Click go-to-definition, Shift+F12 find references, and symbol outline. Also serves as a persistent memory manager for AI agents, fully integrated with TUICommander. MDKB indexes your repositories and exposes a local daemon for fast lookups.
general.hint.confirmBeforeClosingTab: Show a confirmation dialog when closing a terminal tab
general.hint.confirmBeforeQuit: Show a confirmation dialog when closing the app
general.hint.copyOnSelect: Automatically copy selected text to clipboard
general.hint.experimentalFeatures: Opt in to features under active development. Individual options appear below when enabled.
general.hint.experimentalWarning: These features are under active development and may be unstable.
general.hint.finderServiceInstalled: Installed — look for it in Finder's right-click menu.
general.hint.latestVersion: You are on the latest version
general.hint.mdkbNotInstalled: Install MDKB to enable outline, go-to-definition, and find references in the code editor.
general.hint.osc1337FocusAttention: Let terminal programs bring the window to the front or bounce the dock icon (OSC 1337 StealFocus/RequestAttention). Disable if a script or log spams either.
general.hint.osc52Clipboard: Let terminal programs set the system clipboard (OSC 52). A notice appears on each write. Disable to ignore clipboard writes from terminal output.
general.hint.preventSleepWhenBusy: Keep the system awake while scripts are running
general.hint.restoreWindowGeometry: Reopen the app window at the same size and position as when it was last closed
general.hint.scrollbackReflow: Re-wrap scrollback history when the terminal changes width, so old output stays readable after a side panel opens. Turn it off to leave history lines as they were written and truncate them instead. The visible screen is never reflowed either way.
general.hint.shell: Shell used in terminals (leave blank for system default)
general.hint.showBlockTimestamps: While Ctrl+Cmd is held, label each command block with how long ago it started
general.hint.showScrollbarMarks: Mark each command's position on the terminal scrollbar, so a long scrollback shows where output began
general.hint.updateChannel: Choose which release channel to receive updates from
general.toggle.restoreWindowGeometry: Restore window size and position on launch

notifications.hint.notificationEvents: Choose which events play a sound
notifications.hint.silenceRemoteCompleti: Sessions started by an agent orchestrator (session create, agent spawn) finish without a chime. They still appear in Activity and update the badge.
notifications.hint.toastsInBell: Toasts fade on their own, often while you look at another window. Mirroring them into the bell keeps them readable afterwards. Turn this off to leave toasts transient.

repoWorktree.hint.autoDelete: Delete local branch when its PR is merged or closed
repoWorktree.hint.autoFetch: Periodically fetch from remote to keep branch stats fresh
repoWorktree.hint.copyPaths: Copied (or symlinked) into every new worktree of this repo, regardless of the toggles above. Paths are relative to the repository root. Repo-specific — there is no global default for this list.
repoWorktree.hint.copySync: Copying runs in the background after the worktree is created — a toast shows when it starts and finishes.
repoWorktree.hint.displayName: Shown in sidebar instead of folder name
repoWorktree.hint.orphanCleanup: A worktree whose branch was deleted out from under it. 'Auto-archive' and 'Ask' move it aside (recoverable) since detection is a heuristic that can misfire; 'Auto-remove' deletes it outright with no recovery.
repoWorktree.hint.sidebarColor: Color-code this repo in the sidebar
repoWorktree.hint.warmIgnoredDirectories: Copy-on-write copies node_modules, target, and other git-ignored build directories from the parent repo into a new worktree so it starts warm. Runs in the background after creation.
repoWorktree.toggle.autoConsolidate: Show all worktrees of this repo in one consolidated screen
repoWorktree.toggle.deleteBranchOnRemove: Delete local branch when removing worktree
repoWorktree.toggle.promptOnCreate: Prompt for branch name during creation

services.hint.additionalReadableDirs: Absolute directories that web and remote clients may READ files from, in addition to your registered repositories. Desktop reads are never restricted. Never widens writing, copying, or moving. Use ~ for your home directory.
services.hint.autoSave: Settings are saved automatically when changed
services.hint.firewallWarning: Port may be blocked by a firewall
services.hint.httpDescription: Serves the REST API and MCP protocol for AI agents and automation tools
services.hint.ipv6Description: Binds the server to both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. Requires save + server restart.
services.hint.lanAuthBypassDescription: Skips authentication for private/LAN IP addresses (RFC1918, Tailscale, IPv6 ULA)
services.hint.lanAuthBypassWarning: Devices on your local network can access without a password. Only use on trusted networks.
services.hint.mcpConnection: AI agents connect via the tuic-bridge sidecar. MCP configs are auto-installed in supported agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.).
services.hint.passwordLeaveBlank: Leave blank to keep the current password
services.hint.port: TCP port for the remote access web server
services.hint.qrScan: Scan the QR code to connect from another device
services.hint.regenerateToken: Generates a new token, disconnecting all active remote sessions
services.hint.relayDescription: Connect from anywhere via an encrypted WebSocket relay. No port forwarding or VPN needed. Note: traffic is encrypted in transit, but the relay operator can derive the key — this is not end-to-end encryption.
services.hint.relayRestart: Changes require an app restart to take effect.
services.hint.relaySessionId: Shared with the mobile client to join the same relay room. Regenerating disconnects the current mobile session.
services.hint.relayToken: Obtained from the relay server's /register endpoint. Used for both authentication and encryption key derivation — because the relay receives this token, it can derive the key, so traffic is not end-to-end encrypted.
services.hint.remoteAccessWarning: Warning: exposes a web interface on your local network. Secure with a strong password.
services.hint.selfSignedExplain: Without Tailscale HTTPS, TUICommander serves a self-signed certificate so remote/LAN access still gets HTTPS (needed for the clipboard and other browser features that require a secure context). Each device shows a one-time browser security warning the first time it connects — that's expected; accept it to continue. Plain http:// links now redirect to https:// automatically.
services.hint.serverReachable: Server is reachable from the network
services.hint.tailscaleEnableHttps: Enable HTTPS certificates in your Tailscale admin console to serve the PWA over HTTPS.
services.hint.tokenDuration: How long remote sessions stay authenticated. Token always resets on app restart.
services.placeholder.relayToken: Paste token from relay server registration
services.readableDirs.invalid: Must be an absolute path, or start with ~/ for your home directory

settings.copyToProject.heading: Share with Team
settings.copyToProject.hint: Write this repo's worktree/branch settings to a .tuic.json in the project root. Commit it so teammates inherit the same defaults. Scripts are never exported.
settings.globalHotkeyHint: Set an OS-level shortcut to show/hide TUICommander from any application.

remoteServers.hint: Connect to TUIC instances on other machines (SSH, Direct, or a local named instance), or manage SSH port-forwarding tunnels. An SSH connection's encrypted tunnel is created when you Connect, not when you save it.

terminal.hint.blockFoldingEnabled: Allow collapsing a command block's output with Cmd+Shift+. or a gutter click.
terminal.hint.restoreScrollback: Show a restored terminal's recent output above a fresh prompt. Saved as plain text in the app's config directory — off by default.
terminal.hint.restoreScrollbackLines: Maximum lines of output saved per terminal when scrollback saving is on
terminal.hint.restoreShellTerminals: Reopen plain shell tabs (not just agent tabs) in their saved directory when you relaunch
terminal.hint.shell: Shell used in terminals (leave blank for system default)
terminal.hint.shellIntegration: Command blocks need OSC 133 markers from your shell. zsh gets these automatically — bash and fish need one line added to their startup file.
terminal.hint.showBlockMarks: Tick marks on the scrollbar for each command block — red when the command failed.
terminal.hint.showPromptMarks: A green tick mark on the scrollbar for each prompt you sent.

toolbar.filterActiveOn: Showing active repos only — click to show all
